newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks plunge 2.72 pct on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks plunge 2.72 pct on profit-taking.

text.p: Pakistani stocks plunged 2.72 percent on Monday's settlement day on profit-taking, and dealers said market punters were expecting a mixed sentiment on Tuesday's new accounts day.
The Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE) 100-share index plunged 47.63 points, or 2.72 percent, to 1,702.06 amid 265 losers and 99 gainers. Turnover rose to 55.4 million shares from Sunday's 48.8 million.
Profit-taking followed sharp rises in the last trading week, which ended on Thursday, dealer Ali Hussain said. The market expected correction after the rises, broker Majid Chapra said.
